preconditions.description: The number of vertices N is greater than 1.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(edge, list) and len(edge) == 3 for edge in edgeList)
preconditions.description: Each edge in edgeList is a list of three integers.

preconditions.expression: all(edge[0] < edge[1] for edge in edgeList)
preconditions.description: For each edge, the start vertex is less than the end vertex.
Each edge has a positive weight.

postconditions.description: The return value is either the weight of the shortest path or -1 if no path exists.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or all(isinstance(path_weight, int) and path_weight > 0 for path_weight in [edge[2] for edge in edgeList if edge[0] == 0 or edge[1] == N-1])
postconditions.description: If a path exists, the return value is the sum of positive integer weights of the edges in the shortest path.
